text: At its meeting of September 25, 2020, the Board of Directors of TO Live made requests of the City Manager as part of its decision on CT15.1 - "Facilitators for the Board of Directors of TO Live" and the supplementary report from the City Manager, CT15.1a. - "Follow Up on Agenda Item CT12.1 - Advice from the City Manager". This report fulfills the requests from the Board and provides information on agency matters for the Board's consideration in Confidential Attachments 1 and 2.
The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until a special meeting of the Board to be called by the Chair.
